raw.rationale: This is a fluoroquinolone-class antibacterial (e.g., ciprofloxacin/levofloxacin) whose TOP2A inhibition is far more potent against bacterial gyrase than human topoisomerase II, so at 2.5 µM for 5 days it should show little or no selective cytotoxicity across human cancer lineages; any apparent lineage selectivity would be weak and largely attributable to chance or to transporter/efflux differences rather than lineage-specific dependencies.
